title: Nzaghachi nke Ruru n'ocheeze
intro: Onye a na-ebo ebubo bịakwutere oche ikpe ziri ezi, olu ha na-ama jijiji ọ bụghị n'ụjọ kama n'olileanya. Okwu ahụ bụ nke onwe onye, ​​mana mkpebi ya ga-ada ụda ka oge na-aga, na-emebi omenala mmegbu. Ònye bụ mkpụrụ obi a a nụrụ mkpesa ya karịa kpakpando?
clues: Obi m dị arọ bịara, na-achọ ikpe ziri ezi n'okwu nke kechiri ire m.
Arịrịọ m abụghị naanị onye ozi ka m rịọrọ; ọ rịgoro n'elu, nye Onye ahụ nke na-anụ ihe niile.
Okwu ndị a na-ekwu megide m dị ka agbụ ígwè nke oge ochie.
M rụrụ ụka ma tụgharịa uche, n'anya mmiri na n'ụzọ ezi uche, maka ùgwù m.
Mkpughe bịara, mechie ụzọ ochie ma nabata ihe mgbu m.
Ha na-akpọ m onye sere okwu gbasara di m, aha m wee bụrụ otu n'ime isiakwụkwọ nke tọhapụrụ m.

identity.label: Ònye ka m bụ?
options: Nwunye Imran (Nne Meri)
Nwanyị ahụ sere okwu gbasara di ya (Khawla bint Tha'laba)
Eze Nwanyị Sheba (Bilqis)
Nne Mozis
Nwunye Fero (Asiyah)
identity.answer: Nwanyị ahụ sere okwu gbasara di ya (Khawla bint Tha'laba)

trial.label: Ikpe ma ọ bụ Ihe Omume ahụ
options: E boro ya ebubo ụgha maka omume rụrụ arụ
Ọ bụ nwanyị aga, ọ chọkwara nwa
O chere omenala ịgba alụkwaghịm dị ka nke siri ike ihu.
Ọ bụ eze nwanyị na-akparịta ụka na onye amụma
O zoro nwa ya n'aka onye ọchịchị aka ike
trial.answer: O chere omenala ịgba alụkwaghịm dị ka nke siri ike ihu.

location.label: Isi Ihe
options: Nwa ehi ọlaedo
Ocheeze mara mma
Omume nke Zihar
Nkata n'osimiri
Nkwa dị nsọ nke nraranye

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: E nyere ya nwa mgbe o mere agadi.
A zọpụtara ya ka mmiri ghara iri ya
O nwetara mkpughe Chineke nke wepụrụ omenala ahụ
Ọ ghọrọ eze nwanyị mgbe ule gasịrị
E nyere ya nwa nwoke nke ghọrọ onye amụma
outcome.answer: O nwetara mkpughe Chineke nke wepụrụ omenala ahụ

arabic: قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَـٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verse: Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing. (58:1)
